tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon rows establish positive gain but do not constrain the slow timescale or confirm reversal. Since the target forecast horizon is 23.9, acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: author dual-horizon reversal model from current rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations are at short horizons where the fast positive term dominates; the slow adaptation term and reversal behavior near the target horizon are not identified.
More short-range trajectory detail would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
Auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to the identified dual-horizon question and has avoidable cost.
The recalled mechanism and pilot signature favor endogenous adaptation, and current x_now values are all zero, leaving this alternative unsupported.
